integrity: The complete finite domain is enumerated from minimal-winning antichains. Public Good power and dominance are each computed by two independent exact implementations; violating games are canonicalized under all player relabelings; and every first-layer class is independently checked against an explicit integer weighted representation.
scientific_limitations: The exhaustive classification covers proper simple games through five players only. It does not classify six-player or larger games, and the explicit integer weighted representations are certificates rather than uniqueness or minimality claims.
title: Sharp five-player dominance boundary for the Public Good index
